subject: Engineering decisions
title: All fifteen Tamil cases took 272
question: What did the recorded experiment show?
method: Original decision-log entry and measurements are preserved verbatim below.
finding: All fifteen Tamil cases took 272.7–276.0 s across three hosted Android emulators. A focused flow exercised the Android UI server and verified one physical tap in the system IME button. On the local iPhone the editor keyboard journey passed in 15.2 s and reverse flash cards in 18.3 s after reducing redundant accessibility reads.
